item.title: Love this! Nice interior! Almost two acres in Pennsylvania. $275,000
item.description: I love this house! Such a great interior! Love the stained glass in the bathroom! The house was built in 1900. It is located on 1.73 acres in Lewisberry, Pennsylvania. The house features a small covered front porch, updated kitchen, original wood floors, exposed beams, stone wall, stone fireplace, baseboards, sunroom, stained glass window and a claw foot tub. item.title: Pretty setting! Love the moss-draped trees! One acre in South Carolina. $339,000
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! I love the moss-draped trees on the property! The house was built in 1933. It is located on 1.02 acres in St. George, South Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, a large back patio, back deck, wood floors, baseboards, french doors, vintage light fixtures and a claw foot tub. This is a big house! item.description: This house has a pretty setting! It is the former Carr Dairy. The house was built in 1890. It is located on 10.2 acres in La Follette, Tennessee. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, wainscoting, crown moulding, baseboards, walk in pantry and a nice staircase. item.description: Welcome to Oklahoma’s most expensive old house listing! This sure is beautiful! Love the property! The house was built in 1931. It is located on 12 acres in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The house features a beautiful barrel ceiling, five fireplaces, updated kitchen and an elevator. There is a five car garage, large pool, stocked pond, tennis court and a cabana kitchen. item.title: Pretty house! Circa 1803. Almost five acres in Vermont. $529,000
item.description: This is a pretty house and it has a pretty setting! The house was built in 1803. It is located on 4.8 acres in Chester, Vermont. The house features exposed beams, wood floors, a spacious kitchen, built-in china cabinet, wainscoting, chair rails, baseboards and an attic for storage. There is an attached garage and a large barn. Five bedrooms, five bathrooms and 3,880 square feet. $529,000 Contact Daire Gibney with Barrett and Valley Associates: 802-875-2323 From the Zillow listing: Built in 1803,

item.title: Cute cabin! Circa 1930 in Washington. $169,000
item.description: This sure is a cute cabin! Love the kitchen sink! There is also a bunkhouse on the property. The cabin was built in 1930. It is located in Naches, Washington. The cabin features a large deck, vaulted ceiling, wood floors and bead board. There is a small bunkhouse on the property. The cabin is on US forest service land so the lot is under an annual lease. item.title: TWO houses on 11 acres in West Virginia! Pretty setting with a pond. $399,900
item.description: This listing includes two houses! There is some nice acreage and it’s a pretty setting with a pond. The house was built in 1946. It is located on 11.5 acres in Alderson, West Virginia. Both houses could use some updating, but there is great potential there. One house is three bedrooms and one bathroom. The other is four bedrooms and two bathrooms. There is a nice pond and multiple outbuildings on the property. Seven bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,924 square feet. $399,900 Contact David and Cynd
